This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] trooper.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> she was aboard a military hauler-speeder on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when she and three fellow troopers responded to what appeared to be an assault involving [[Myri Antilles]] and [[Voort saBinring]], members of the recently reformed [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]]. After their vehicle landed beside the Wraiths' parked [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], the [[Unidentified Army hauler pilot|pilot]] led the squad toward the pair to intervene while Antilles ran behind him, pretending to seek protection.<ref name="MK" />

Moments later, Antilles signaled saBinring to drop to the ground. [[Trey Courser]], another member of Wraith Squadron, then emerged from his hiding place inside the Wraith's speeder and [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the pilot and the female trooper with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. Antilles stunned the [[Unidentified Galactic Alliance trooper (Myri Antilles victim)|trooper]] who had attempted to comfort her with her [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], as well as the lone remaining [[Unidentified male Galactic Alliance trooper|trooper]] who attempted to retreat into the hauler. The Wraiths then commandeered the military hauler-speeder as part of their [[Army hauler hijack|mission]].<ref name="MK" />
